comment: Design tokens (docs/design/04 §0, 08 §6, 09 §5.3). Tools/ui-tokens.mjs turns this file into Unity/Assets/Game/Presentation/UI/Resources/UI/Styles/Tokens.uss: each group listed in 'groups' becomes CSS variables --<prefix>-<kebab-key>, numbers get the group's unit, strings pass through (percentages, rgba). Kit and screen USS may only use these variables (the check fails on raw colours or lengths). Colours are the shipped palette (ui/theme.json) plus the role colours 04 §0 names (ready green, destructive red, neutral brown and gold). Durations are also read by code through TokenKeys (hold-to-confirm, refusal, tooltip delay, gate settle).
